claims.claim: Bank of Israel Directive 364 (Management of IT, Information Security, and Cyber Protection Risks), published November 2024 and effective 18 May 2026, consolidates and supersedes the legacy Directives 357 (Management of Information Technology), 361 (Cyber Defense Management), and 363. Directive 366 governs reporting of technological-failure and cyber events; Directive 362 governs cloud-computing approval.
claims.raw_snippet: הוראת ניהול בנקאי תקין מס' 364 ... מאחדת שלוש הוראות קודמות: 357, 361, 363

claims.claim: Under Amendment 13 the PPA must be notified of a serious security incident immediately (the law says 'immediately', not a GDPR-style fixed 72-hour clock); DPO appointment is mandatory for public bodies and large-scale sensitive-data processors.
claims.raw_snippet: חובה לדווח באופן מיידי לרשות להגנת הפרטיות על כל 'אירוע אבטחה חמור'

claims.claim: INCD published a draft National Cyber Defense Law (tazkir) on 22 January 2026 imposing binding controls on 'essential organizations' and codifying CERT-IL / INCD authority; it is not yet enacted as of May 2026.
claims.raw_snippet: ביום ה-22 בינואר 2026, פורסם תזכיר חוק הגנת הסייבר הלאומית ... מעמד של 'ארגון חיוני'

claims.claim: Health sector cyber rules expect high system availability, around 99.9% for critical clinical systems.
